_comment: Single source of truth for every price on the website: the pricing page, the homepage packages and the estimator all read from here. Amounts are whole rupees, before GST. Build prices come from the original estimator; care-plan prices were proposed on 2026-09-24 and should be confirmed by the founder.
note: Prices in INR, before GST where applicable. Every project gets a fixed quote after a free discovery conversation.

steps.title: Free first conversation
steps.text: Tell us the problem. We ask questions, separate facts from assumptions, and tell you honestly if you don't need custom software at all.

steps.title: One fixed price
steps.text: A written proposal with what's in scope, what isn't, the timeline and the price. No hourly meter running.

steps.title: Pay as it progresses
steps.text: 40% on approval, 40% when you review the working version, 20% on delivery.

steps.title: Changes priced up front
steps.text: New ideas mid-project are welcome. Each one comes with its cost and time before any work starts.

faq.a: Because the problem sets the price, not the page count. The "from" price is what the simplest version of that kind of project costs. You get a fixed quote after we understand what you need, before you commit to anything.
Prices are shown before GST. Where GST applies, it's added on the invoice and shown separately in your proposal.

faq.q: What if my budget is lower?
faq.a: Tell us. We'll usually suggest a smaller first version that solves the most painful part of the problem, and grow it later.
No. It's optional and you can start or stop it at any time. If you'd rather host and maintain the system yourself, we hand over everything you need.
You do, once the project is paid for: source code, database and every asset.
